aggregation: arithmetic mean of row scores per canonical identity; order-independent sorted math.fsum
primary_metric: SURROGATE DEVELOPMENT AUROC at canonical-identity level
selection_scope: independent target x split-seed cell; no cross-seed pooling
surrogate_interpretation: Surrogate-based scorer selection estimates development discrimination against the predefined surrogate unknown families only. It does not establish performance on the held-out target family.
tie_rationale: P5 froze nearest_centroid_l2 on exact tie; P6 extends numerical equality to 1e-12 while retaining P5's centroid preference.
